desc_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 健康科技學院碩士班。以 R 語言為核心工具，系統性介紹從描述統計到結構方程模型（SEM）的完整分析流程，每週提供可執行語法與範例資料。
desc_en: Graduate course at NTUNHS College of Health Technology. Uses R as the core tool, covering the full pipeline from descriptive statistics to structural equation modeling, with runnable code and sample data each week.

title_zh: E-Badge｜智慧電子檢傷標識系統
title_en: E-Badge: Smart Electronic Triage Tag System
desc_zh: 平時是床頭卡，災時三秒轉換為國際通用 START 檢傷卡與疏散優先卡。NTUNHS 健康科技學院 × 資訊工業策進會產學合作，概念驗證於場域測試中。
desc_en: An e-paper resident tag that doubles as a bedside card in daily use and switches to a START triage/evacuation-priority card in seconds during a disaster. A proof-of-concept collaboration between NTUNHS and III, currently in field testing.

desc_zh: 國立臺灣師範大學 健康促進與衛生教育學系大學部課程，全英語授課（EMI）。課程網站彙整每週教材、學生小組專題與成果展示。
desc_en: Undergraduate course at NTNU's Department of Health Promotion and Health Education, taught in English (EMI). The site hosts weekly materials, student group projects, and a showcase of past work.

title_zh: 高階專業人員 EMT-1 × 社區韌性
desc_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 健康科技學院碩士班「社區韌性專題與實務研析」。以臺灣 EMT-1 法定能力與消防署教材為核心，結合國際 CPG 與實務影音做高階延伸。
desc_en: NTUNHS graduate seminar "Community Resilience: Topics and Practice." Built around Taiwan's statutory EMT-1 competencies and the fire agency's official curriculum, extended with international clinical practice guidelines.

desc_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 健康科技學院碩士班「韌性科技專題研討」。探討 AI、GIS、穿戴式裝置與數位協作平台如何賦能災難應變，每週搭配一篇 SCI 開放取用全文文獻導讀。
desc_en: NTUNHS graduate seminar exploring how AI, GIS, wearables, and digital collaboration platforms empower disaster response, with a weekly open-access SCI paper and short guided reading.

title_zh: 生命的節奏｜大學新生 CPR 與 AED 急救訓練
title_en: The Rhythm of Life: Freshman CPR & AED Training
desc_zh: 國立臺北護理健康大學 115學年度新生急救教學講義，依 AHA《2025年心肺復甦術與心血管急救指引》設計，涵蓋叫叫CABD、AED操作與出血控制，含示範影片、操作練習與情境挑戰測驗。
desc_en: NTUNHS freshman first-aid orientation slide deck for the 115th academic year, built on the AHA 2025 CPR & ECC guidelines. Covers recognition, high-quality compressions, AED use, and bleeding control, with demo videos, hands-on practice stations, and scenario quizzes.
